name: branding-forest-green-lime-travel-brand-bento-board
title: Forest Green and Lime Travel Brand Bento
whatItIs: A bento brand board on white: a lime-rimmed phone with an explore screen, a store listing on dotted lime, a tour card, a lime tile with a white script wordmark, stat tiles (60+ screens, 10+ flows), a contour map line, category icon tiles and an app icon close-up.
whatItMeans: Forest green and lime feel natural and energetic, and the bento mixes logo, UI and stats to sell completeness.
techniques: Script wordmark on a lime gradient tile
Contour-map tile with a glowing route line
Lime icon tiles on dark green
Stat tiles with big lime numerals

vocabulary.definition: A grid of differently sized tiles presenting brand assets.
Topographic lines used as a graphic texture.
A tile showing one large number and label.
